name: recordings_visual_identity_decide
title: Answer a visible-person identity check
description: Records one source-current human answer about the exact visible person marked in one Recording frame. Yes confirms only the displayed face-to-person proposal; Someone else records the rejected proposed person and one separately selected displayed candidate atomically; Not sure is neutral; Not a person rejects only that exact detection. This never confirms or renames an audio speaker track, changes captions, chooses a Thumbnail, approves a Speaker photo, trusts a face reference, stores a reusable face template, or changes recognition consent. A non-neutral answer queues a bounded person-evidence generation so affected automatic Thumbnail evidence can be reconsidered without overwriting a manual Thumbnail.

recording_id.description: Recording public ID that owns the exact current visual question.

visual_identity_question_id.description: Opaque source-current question ID returned inside recording speaker evidence.

decision.description: Exact visual answer. The UI presents these as Yes, Use the selected person, Someone else, Not sure, and Not a person.

selected_speaker_profile_id.description: Required for identified or someone_else; must be one of the canonical scoped candidates displayed with this exact question.

new_person_name.description: A new visible person’s name, instead of a selected profile. Creates a project-local person without assigning a voice or approving memory.

question_context.description: The opaque displayed question_context, unchanged; it preserves exact-image and proposal meaning across background publication.

reason.description: Optional short human context retained with the decision receipt.

supersedes_decision_id.description: Optional current decision ID when deliberately appending a correction to the same exact question.

idempotency_key.description: Caller-stable retry key for this exact answer.

speaker_evidence.description: Refreshed bounded speaker evidence and remaining visual identity questions.
